prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: OpenAI chat bot extrenal api query help
We have a complex chat bot using no code chatbot Landbot & integromat. This has Alot of limitations. I would like you to format the api in openai davinci in order to make a virtual sales assistant. I know how to do most of this but im stuck with external api calls etc we provide courier services. we need to integrate 1. validation of user inputted postcode or address using google maps api 2. distance between those addresses using google maps distance matrix we would then use the miles to work out pricing etc. Is this something you can help with if so when?
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Streaming chat widget
client: Quillstack
client_industry: edtech
start: 2025-02
end: 2025-04
engagement: hourly
stack:
- React
- TypeScript
- Server-Sent Events
- Node.js
- OpenAI API
built: The front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token
  by token.
metrics:
- first token on screen in about 600 ms
- 30k chats a month

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Streaming chat widget (p16).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi — I’m a passionate, hard-working developer with 7 years of experience building full stack web apps.

I can help you move this chatbot beyond Landbot/Integromat limitations and set up the external API flow you need for postcode/address validation and distance-based pricing. I’ve worked extensively with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, and PostgreSQL, so integrating Google Maps APIs and wiring the logic into your OpenAI-powered sales assistant is well within my wheelhouse.

Recently, I built a Streaming chat widget for Quillstack in edtech, including a React front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. It reached about 600 ms to first token on screen and handled 30k chats a month.

If you’d like, I can help you structure the API calls, validation flow, and pricing logic so the bot can reliably quote courier services.
